proof_boundaries: Passing or failing synthetic probes says nothing about biological validity
A recipe does not prove a run completed or that its output matches a published model
The corpus acceptance rate is a measurement, not a quality score

Condition labels are reconstructed from committed methods and timestamps, not recorded in the raw receipts
